summary: Sorting of Folder pane in Messenger is not following systems locale in SeaMonkey 2.53.3
description:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; rv:60.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/60.0 SeaMonkey/2.53.3

Steps to reproduce:

Using Foldername with Danish character Å or Aa in Messenger for Folder names

Actual results:

The folders in the Folder Pane starting with Aa and Å is sorted before and after A.

Expected results:

The folders starting with Å and Aa should be sorted last (after Z) according to Danish locale.

SeaMonkey 2.49.5 did this correctly - see attached file.
